primary_journey.title: A customer gets a queue ticket, is called by staff, is served, and the result shows in admin analytics
steps: Switch to demo customer Emma Brown
Select Central Branch and General Consultation, choose Walk-in Queue and generate a ticket
Open My Tickets and note ticket number, position and estimated wait
Switch to staff Michael Chen (Central, counter 2), complete his seeded Serving ticket CEN-CS-001, then click Call Next (repeat with completion until the customer's ticket is called)
Return to the customer's My Tickets view without refreshing the page
As staff click Start Service then Complete Service
Switch to admin Jordan Ellis and open the dashboard
expected: Ticket CEN-GC-005 (next sequence after seeded CEN-GC-004) is shown with status Waiting
Position and estimated wait are shown (position = waiting tickets ahead + 1, wait = sum of ahead tickets' service minutes)
Staff dashboard shows the called customer as current; the earliest waiting ticket at the branch is the one called (FIFO)
The customer's ticket changes to Called within a few seconds without manual refresh
Ticket moves Serving then Completed and appears in the customer's history
Admin completed count and average service duration include the new ticket
All tickets, statuses and statistics persist after refresh
